poweradditions.component.property.vf_red: Typical forward voltage of the red die at 20 mA (datasheet). It rises slightly with current.
poweradditions.component.property.rs_red: Internal series resistance of the red die; sets how steeply the voltage rises with current.
poweradditions.component.property.vbr_re: Reverse voltage at which the red die breaks down and is destroyed. LEDs block reverse current below this.
poweradditions.component.property.wl_red: Dominant wavelength of the red die.
poweradditions.component.property.mcd_re: Typical luminous intensity of the red die at 20 mA. Output scales roughly with current.
poweradditions.component.property.vf_gre: Typical forward voltage of the green die at 20 mA (datasheet). It rises slightly with current.
poweradditions.component.property.rs_gre: Internal series resistance of the green die; sets how steeply the voltage rises with current.
poweradditions.component.property.vbr_gr: Reverse voltage at which the green die breaks down and is destroyed. LEDs block reverse current below this.
poweradditions.component.property.wl_gre: Dominant wavelength of the green die.
poweradditions.component.property.mcd_gr: Typical luminous intensity of the green die at 20 mA. Output scales roughly with current.
poweradditions.component.property.vf_blu: Typical forward voltage of the blue die at 20 mA (datasheet). It rises slightly with current.
poweradditions.component.property.rs_blu: Internal series resistance of the blue die; sets how steeply the voltage rises with current.
poweradditions.component.property.vbr_bl: Reverse voltage at which the blue die breaks down and is destroyed. LEDs block reverse current below this.
poweradditions.component.property.wl_blu: Dominant wavelength of the blue die.
poweradditions.component.property.mcd_bl: Typical luminous intensity of the blue die at 20 mA. Output scales roughly with current.
poweradditions.component.property.min_cu: Below this forward current the LED gives no visible light.
tooltip.poweradditions.dismantle: Shift + right-click to take apart into single LEDs
poweradditions.component.property.pmax_r: Datasheet power rating of the red die. Real LEDs only fail well above it, once the junction reaches its maximum temperature.
poweradditions.component.property.pmax_g: Datasheet power rating of the green die. Real LEDs only fail well above it, once the junction reaches its maximum temperature.
poweradditions.component.property.pmax_b: Datasheet power rating of the blue die. Real LEDs only fail well above it, once the junction reaches its maximum temperature.
poweradditions.component.property.max_te: At this junction temperature the die overheats: smoke, a spark, then it is dead. Fans on the board cool it.
tooltip.poweradditions.repair_white: Craft with 1 Quartz + the ore of each burnt die to repair
tooltip.poweradditions.dismantle_working: Shift + right-click to take apart into a red, green and blue LED
